purpose: Independent synthetic animation truthfulness cases for fleet flowchart

cases.old_start: Prior turn: agent started without terminal event. Session is now ready, no active opinion. Should UI animate?
cases.active_agent: Current snapshot opinion has status running. Its matching agent event is started. Should UI animate?
cases.configured_only: Agent is configured but has no runtime events and no active opinion. Should UI animate?
cases.terminal: Current agent event completed and session is ready. Should UI animate?
